attr.title: MaternalBound Redux (Native)
attr.desc: Native C/C++ Linux port of MaternalBound Redux for ARM64 handhelds.
attr.inst: This port requires a user-generated gamedata/assets.pak from a compatible MaternalBound Redux setup. Place it at ports/ebredux/gamedata/assets.pak. The asset pack is not included. This is an early community port; compatibility and controls are still being validated.
